stem:
Deepak looks at two even numbers and asks when their sum is a multiple of 4.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: Any sum of two even numbers may be labeled a multiple of 4.
Every sum of two even numbers is a multiple of 4, with no further check.
The sum is a multiple of 4 when the two even numbers leave the same remainder on division by 4.
The same remainder rule also applies unchanged when one addend is odd.

teacher.key_rationale: Each even number is 0 or 2 more than a multiple of 4. Their sum is a multiple of 4 precisely when those remainders match. Labeling any even sum as a multiple of 4 substitutes the name for the test. Claiming every even sum works omits the remainder condition. Extending the rule to an odd addend without reworking cases is outside this hinge.

mx_swap.reason: Printed-numeral capture is weaker than label-substitution, missing-remainder omission, and odd-addend scope error; kept those three.
